# Sanity

Skills that teach agents to work with Sanity. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [sanity-io/agent-toolkit](https://github.com/sanity-io/agent-toolkit), at commit `88d6cdf`.

Model content, write GROQ and Portable Text, and upgrade Sanity Studio.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Sanity**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Sanity**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install sanity@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

8 skills: `content-experimentation-best-practices`, `content-modeling-best-practices`, `portable-text-conversion`, `portable-text-serialization`, `sanity-best-practices`, `sanity-migration`, `sanity-studio-upgrade`, `seo-aeo-best-practices`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The vendor's MCP server (`https://mcp.sanity.io`), slash commands and package files are not included.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/sanity-io/agent-toolkit
